where: Helia Vault (the Sunsketch puzzle reliquary off Sunvault Climb II)
mood: First Light at the Top: Solar warmth meets the first true starlight - the climbing hook at its highest, doubled in bells, inside a sunlit reliquary of blooms and sun-mirrors.
core_styles: pulse-wave lead doubled an octave higher by bright glassy bells
sparkling ascending bell arpeggios like sunlight caught in mirrors
harp arpeggios over a warm sustained pad

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {entering a sunlit reliquary: a cascade of glassy bells rising like light striking a mirror, a pad bloom and a short drum roll into the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the climbing hook at its highest: lead and bells in octaves, bright and curious, steady groove for thinking on your feet}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the hook again with a harp counter-melody weaving between the bell phrases, pad fuller}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a puzzle-pondering passage in B minor - plucked staccato figures, a ticking hi-hat, the lead asking questions in short phrases, then bells climbing back toward the answer}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the brilliant hook returns with bells blazing; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
